mapper.select: SELECT u.USER_NO AS userNo, u.USER_ID AS userId, u.NICKNAME AS nickname, u.EMAIL AS email, u.PHONE AS phone, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS profileImageUrl, ( SELECT TRIM(a.ADDRESS1 || ' ' || NVL(a.ADDRESS2, '')) FROM OFT_USER_ADDRESS a WHERE a.USER_NO = u.USER_NO AND a.IS_DEFAULT = 'Y' ) AS defaultAddress, NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(oi.SAVED_AMOUNT, 0)) FROM OFT_ORDERS o JOIN OFT_ORDER_ITEM oi ON oi.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE o.USER_NO = u.USER_NO ), 0) AS totalSavedAmount FROM OFT_USERS u WHERE u.USER_NO = #{userNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OFT_USERS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(EMAIL)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{email})) AND USER_NO != #{userNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OFT_USERS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(NICKNAME)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{nickname})) AND USER_NO != #{userNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE OFT_USERS SET NICKNAME = #{nickname}, EMAIL = #{email}, PHONE = #{phone}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
